summary: Grenoble, France, software engineer, PhD in computer science, strong advocate for free and open-source software, user of Linux (specifically KDE Plasma and Ubuntu), interests in programming languages (Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, C, D, Haskell), enjoys contributing to open-source projects, has experience with web development and browser technologies, values user privacy and minimalism in software design, actively participates in discussions about software ethics and digital rights, family-oriented, has a grandmother he helps with technology, uses self-hosted services (e.g., email, cloud storage), enjoys hiking and outdoor activities, has a strong interest in technology and its societal impacts.
